symptom: Make notion:makeApiCall runtime input visibly contains page_size/filter body, but Notion returns the default 100 records and ignores body semantics.
rootCause: For the proven data-source query route, an object body is not sufficient evidence that the outgoing Notion request applies the body. The working pattern uses a serialized JSON string, explicit Content-Type application/json, Notion version 2025-09-03, and literal filter_properties[] query parameters.
failedApproaches: URL-encoded filter_properties%5B%5D with old/default Notion version: Invalid request URL.
Correct literal filter_properties[] and version 2025-09-03 with object body: request succeeds but page_size/filter are ignored; default 100 rows return.
Treat the Make module input card showing a body object as proof that Notion applied that body.
provenFix: Use serialized JSON string body plus Content-Type: application/json, version 2025-09-03, and literal filter_properties[] in URL. Canary execution 12f5046d574a407ba389ef98f38e935e changed the same BG89 shadow query from 100 rows to exactly 5 with body {page_size:5}.
regressionContract: Verify response semantics, not only module input: requested page_size must equal actual result count when enough rows exist.
Eligibility filters are only certified when forbidden record classes are absent from returned rows.
A successful HTTP/Make execution with ignored request semantics is RED, not GREEN.
Do not promote BG89 shadow until bounded count and all eligibility exclusions are runtime-proven.
